segments.dry: One reviewer describes it as a thick, heavy cream well suited to dry skin, though the jar contains little product.
segments.sensitive: Two reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation and consider it well tolerated, one calling it hard to find products that work for her skin.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 60s reports softer, plumper, firmer-feeling skin and less noticeable fine lines with regular use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers mention fewer visible fine lines and firmer, plumper-looking skin, including a reviewer in her 60s who made it part of her daily routine.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the cream leaves skin hydrated, plump and soft, but one reviewer found it not hydrating at all despite a heavy, slow-absorbing texture.
concerns.barrier: No reviews specifically discuss barrier repair.
concerns.spots: No reviews specifically discuss spots or dark marks.
concerns.blemishes: No reviews specifically discuss acne or blemishes.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describe the cream as absorbing without a greasy or heavy after-feel, with none reporting increased oiliness.

Super thick cream, but is great for dry skin. Theres a light scent to it but it's not over powering. There isn't a lot of product itself in the container, however, a little goes a long way when using.

I have purchased many very expensive moisturizers over the years from luxury skincare brands, and I can honestly say the Medicube Triple Collagen Cream is one of the best moisturizers I've ever used. It leaves my skin feeling incredibly soft, hydrated, smooth, and plump without feeling greasy or heavy. My skin has a beautiful, healthy glow, and I've noticed that my fine lines look less noticeable. It keeps my skin moisturized all day, and my complexion feels firmer and more refreshed. As someone in my 60s who is committed to taking great care of my skin, this cream has earned a permanent place in both my morning and evening skincare routine. It layers beautifully over my serums and works wonderfully under makeup. If you've been spending a fortune on high-end moisturizers, don't overlook this one. In my experience, it performs just as well as—if not better than—many luxury creams that cost several times more. I highly recommend it and will definitely be purchasing it again!
